source: Google Search Console via connected OpenSEO read-only tool

measurementScope.filterMethod: One exact page-equals native filter per request; dates grouped separately; no catalogue, fiches or documentary center requested.

requested28DayComparison.interpretation: No valid 28/28 comparison. Missing dates and empty previous responses are unknown, not measured zero traffic. Earliest returned date is not proof of property creation date.

descriptive7DayComparison.interpretation: Seven explicit daily rows exist in both windows. Per-page descriptions are possible. Tiny counts and a zero-impression baseline prevent a relative growth rate or causal claim.

calculationRules: No missing date was added or imputed.
Zero clicks or impressions are preserved only when explicit source rows exist.
CTR is clicks divided by impressions, never an average of daily CTR. CTR is null when impressions are zero.
Weighted position is derived from source daily position weighted by impressions; its precision is limited by the connector daily values. No impression means position null, never position zero.
Per-page figures remain per-page. No page sums are presented as native property/segment totals or visits.
No relative growth percentage is computed when the earlier value is zero.
No indexation or query-brand metrics are inferred from performance rows. See the separate verified index-status and brand records.

limitations: All requested dates are historical and end before the 19 November publication.
Twenty-eight day windows lack adequate coverage.
Seven-day comparison has a very small sample and zero impressions in the earlier window for all ten eligible pages.
New company/tax pages are not compared against dates when they were not yet published.
A performance impression is a recorded Search appearance; it does not certify current indexing of every URL or business conversion.
